title: if let Some(ref path) uses deprecated ref-binding style
description: server_stores.rs build_credential_store uses 'if let Some(ref path) = auth.credential_file' (explicit ref pattern). Since Rust 2021 match ergonomics, the idiomatic form is 'if let Some(path) = &auth.credential_file', which is what clippy::pattern_type_mismatch / clippy::needless_borrow recommends. The ref keyword in patterns is rarely needed since edition 2018 and is a signal the author was writing older-style code.
